text:
Sasha: heads-up — planning a small canary tonight for the runtime kernel + quant profile bump on dedicated pool. target window 23:30 UTC (15:30 PST). need deploy owner, smoke runner, and rollback checklist. :rocket:
Ryan: I can own the deploy. I’ll claim the slot and run the orchestrator. need the exact slot id and smoke commands.
Sasha: slot is canary-7 (dedicated-pool zone-b). claim with `claim-slot canary-7` and then `deploy --slot=canary-7 --kernel=jit-1.4 --quant=quant-v2`. keep bursts off.
Lara: I’ll run the smoke tests and basic eval set. plan: 5 warmup requests, 30 sample prompts from `smoke/prompts/latency_set.csv`, then run `smoke-check --trace`. I’ll post the raw latency histogram. :eyes:
DeployBot: Slot canary-7 successfully claimed by Ryan at 1712003600. CI checks OK.
Ryan: deploy command I’ll run (dry-run first):
```
./deploy canary --slot=canary-7 \
  --kernel=jit-1.4 \
  --quant-profile=quant-v2 \
  --dry-run
```
Then cut real at +10m if dry-run OK.
Michael: note — before cut, make sure KV cache TTL is set to 0 for the canary to avoid cache pollution, then re-enable if stable. run `kvctl flush-prefix canary-7/*` after warmup.
Clair: rollback plan: snapshot current prod slot (prod-2024-11-08) and keep rollback playbook handy. rollback command is `switch-traffic --from=canary-7 --to=prod-previous --force=false`. also ensure routing fallback to the lighter model variant if latency > 1s.
Sasha: quick checklist for smoke pass: p95 latency < 450ms, error rate < 0.5%, token throughput within 10% of baseline, no memory growth on any node after 15m. if any trigger, immediate rollback.
Lara: I’ll watch PR regressions and run the quality eval (eval-kit quick-check). I’ll post a pass/fail table in this thread within 12 minutes of cut.
Ryan: plan: start dry-run at 23:20 UTC, cut at 23:30 UTC if dry-run is clean. I’ll ping @Sasha @Lara @Michael in thread when I start.
Sasha: thanks — if anyone else wants to observe, join the zoom I’ll drop in #eng-runtime. I’ll also schedule a 30m smoke window after cut for post-deploy checks. :white_check_mark:
Lara: copy. I’ll prepare the prompt set and alert dashboards (p95, 5xx, token-rate).
Michael: I’ll have a rollback hotkey ready and monitor infra metrics. ping me if error rate > 0.3% during warmup.
Clair: I’ll verify canary logs for OOMs and kernel warnings; if we see `kv cache miss spike` we abort and rollback.
Ryan: all set. I’ll post status updates as I go.
Sasha: perfect — thanks team.
